title: Entangling power and fidelity diagnostic for bipartite quantum channels
summary: We study two distinct diagnostics of bipartite quantum channels: the average fidelity between a desired state and noisy output across different classes of input states, and generation of entanglement from pure product input states, quantified by well-defined entangling power. These diagnostics are generally independent, but together they provide a more complete description of bipartite channels.
